thread:
Sonia (Sales): ACME wants a single-package commit: API + Optimize + Console add-ons. 12-month term, quarterly true-ups, one invoice/PO line. Can we map pricing and any required surcharges?
Maya (Solutions): Drafting an initial proposal: API commit 12M tokens @ 0.018 $/k tokens with 25% commit discount; Optimize 1.2M calls with 18% off; Console seats 80 seats with 12% discount over list. POC: 45-day free Optimize up to 150k calls, then pro-rate against commit. Will validate with deal desk.
Elliot (Deal Desk): Need SKU granularity: treat API as token SKU, Optimize as call SKU, Console as seat SKU. Billing model? monthly consumption true-up with committed floors, or prepay? Also confirm whether POC credit reduces the committed amount or is a one-time invoice credit.
Sonia (Sales): Customer insists POC credits show as a line-item credit on first invoice, not reducing the nominal commit. They want option to convert to shorter 6mo if usage materially below estimates after POC.
Elliot (Deal Desk): We can allow a 6mo conversion option but will require an early-termination fee (ETF). Propose ETF = 5% of remaining committed value, plus a minimum monthly floor equal to 30% of original monthly commit.
Alex (Security): ACME's questionnaire: must support SAML/Okta SSO, EU-only data residency, KMS integration (customer-managed keys), and audit log retention request for 6 years. Also asked for SOC2 report and recent pentest summary.
Jess (Legal): 6-year retention is outside standard. Our baseline is 2 years. Extended retention requires an addendum and storage surcharge. Confirm whether they want raw request payloads retained — that's a higher risk vector.
Sonia (Sales): ACME will accept redaction of PII but wants request metadata and non-sensitive prompts retained for 6 years for compliance.
Maya (Solutions): Technical note: routing to EU region + KMS is doable. Extended audit retention will add storage + egress costs; rough estimate +$9k/yr for the requested retention and access SLA. Also: the Optimize POC will warm caches and KV stores — likely to lower steady-state per-token cost by ~3-6% after warmup. That should be disclosed.
Elliot (Deal Desk): Adjusted blended discount to account for retention surcharge and POC credits: API 22%, Optimize 14%, Console 10%, plus a one-time POC credit of $8,000 on first invoice. I'll prepare rate card lines and PSR for approval.
Sonia (Sales): Please draft the customer-facing email with line items, the POC acceptance checkbox, and the tenant provisioning condition. They want to sign this week if legal/security greenlights.
Alex (Security): We'll require SOC2 report, ATO checklist, and a documented KMS key rotation policy before production keys are accepted. I'll push required artifacts to the SSO/KMS section in the questionnaire and DM ACME pre-sales.
Elliot (Deal Desk): @Finance will need ARR/commit number to finalize tiering. Sonia, share expected ARR and I'll route for final sign-off; target turnaround 48-72h.
Sonia (Sales): ARR/commit expected around $512k ARR on the 12-month structure. Sharing numbers now.
DeployBot (bot): Deployment request created for tenant `acme-eu-2` — ID deploy-202604-1123. Status: provisioning.
Sonia (Sales): Adding POC clause: POC credits redeemable only if tenant is provisioned within 21 days of LOI and POC work begins within 14 days of provisioning.
Elliot (Deal Desk): Noted. I'll include ETF, retention surcharge, and the POC provisioning clause in the approval packet. Expecting legal/security signoff window ~48h.
Maya (Solutions): I'll assemble a short POC runbook and include a sample Prometheus/Grafana dashboard snippet for performance SLOs in the SOW. Snippet to include in SOW: 
```
- target_latency_p95: <200ms
- min_throughput: 120rps
- optimize_success_rate: >=99%
```
Sonia (Sales): Great — schedule a 30m sync after deal desk draft. If we get signoff this week ACME can start onboarding immediately.
ACME_Buyer (Customer): Thanks team. Confirm Okta SSO is OK and EU-only tenancy. Also can we get the POC dashboard before Thursday?
